summary: Fork Recipes is a self-hosted tool designed to help you organise and manage culinary recipes in a digital format. It provides a centralised space for storing cooking instructions and ingredient lists through a web-based interface. While specific input methods and formatting options are not detailed, it addresses the standard requirements of personal recipe administration.
goodFor: This is suitable if you want a dedicated, self-hosted option specifically for organising personal recipes rather than relying on commercial cloud notebooks.
watchOut: The project exhibits at-risk maintenance indicators, which means you may encounter unpatched bugs or a lack of timely updates.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your recipe data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
